result.summary: Built, deployed and really executed the missing E3 production execution leg, then re-evaluated Stage 2 honestly. New `exec-brain/e3_execution.py` adds `ExecutionAdapterRegistry` (dispatch refused with WorkerNotRoutable unless the registry says routable=true), `OrchestrationStore` (schema-v2 dag_node/dag_state_event/performance_evidence persistence) and `E3ProductionExecutor` (READY->RUNNING->VERIFYING->COMPLETE, REWORK + re-dispatch on a genuine verifier rejection), gated so a node reaches COMPLETE only after a deterministic verification PASS; `E3ShadowOrchestrator.orchestrate_and_execute()` wires the dispatch step into the orchestrator; `e3_cli.py` supplies the e3-* bindings. Deployed 29 E3 modules and all 10 e3-* CLI bindings to %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\exec-brain via scripts/deploy_e3_runtime.py (per-file backup + SHA-256 manifest + --restore; E1/E2 files untouched apart from the one e3-* registration hook in eb.py). Real-path rehearsal (5 bounded provider calls: deepseek 3, codex-cli 1, google 1) recorded: deepseek rejection -> targeted repair -> re-verification PASS, deepseek first-pass PASS, codex-cli COMPLETE, and a credential-missing worker refused with ZERO provider calls; live orchestration.db upgraded to v2 and read back with 5 dag_node / 20 dag_state_event / 4 performance_evidence rows and 5 new governor.db observed_request rows written only through the public governor.record_request() interface. Unresolved: the Google image worker's real dispatch returned no image part (provider reported 17 prompt tokens, 0 output tokens). Stage 2 was NOT enabled - the live running contract (1ba7f43, 2026-09-23T21:04Z) directs that it not be enabled in this task regardless of outcome, so no criterion was weakened and none was treated as satisfied by approval text. Three truth defects found and fixed (gemini output-token mapping; e3_commands hardcoded schema version; rehearsal CLI-binding detector). Regression: 10 suites, 323/323 passed, 0 failed, exit 0 at SHA 6c19a01. Exactly one successor agent-* task staged.
